validations.title: Cross-Class Field Effect Quantification
validations.oneline: Adjacent-normal tissue elevated across 24 TCGA cancers; field effect = 22.9% of tumor signal

validations.title: Plasma cfDNA Pan-Cancer Correlation
validations.oneline: FAILED (1/3) — confirms tissue-architectural ΔA does NOT predict plasma alteration rate. Reaffirms VAL-002 finding that plasma requires deconvolution.

validations.title: Spatial Field Effect Gradient
validations.oneline: 6/6 cancers show monotonic decay T→N→F→H; far-adjacent (≥5-10cm) still elevated ΔA=+0.025

validations.title: AD Multi-Class Peripheral Drift
validations.oneline: 4 classes elevated in AD (terminal, immune, secretory, stromal); 7/7 severity gradient

validations.title: Tissue-of-Origin Deconvolution Localization
validations.oneline: 10/10 correct primary-site identification; mean max ΔA = +0.174 at correct tissue

validations.title: Monotonic Pre-Cancer Progression
validations.oneline: 5/5 progressions monotonic; tier structure universal across cervical, Barrett's, prostate, colon, AML

validations.title: Cross-Species Cancer Replication
validations.oneline: 5/5 canine cancers match human within ±0.025; canine aging r=0.9995

validations.title: Post-Treatment Reserve Depletion
validations.oneline: 5/5 trials separate responders from non-responders by A trajectory; CR→NORMAL tier

validations.title: Inversion Detection Specificity
validations.oneline: Seminoma INVERSION confirmed (A=0.755); pluripotent-class window is so narrow all histologies depart — divergence magnitude distinguishes seminoma at 2.1× others

validations.title: Systemic Multi-Class Pre-Diagnostic Signature
validations.oneline: 9/9 endpoints elevated pre-diagnostic; 3 classes elevated; detectable 2-5 years before clinical diagnosis
